Hero.name: Anthony
Hero.description: Software Engineer focused on industrial process digitalization. I build scalable solutions that transform complex data into intuitive interfaces for web, mobile, and desktop.

About.title: About Me
About.description: Engineer focused on bridging the gap between physical processes and digital efficiency. My specialty is designing and developing software ecosystems that not only function but optimize operational productivity.
About.description2: Proficient in the Full-stack (Vue, Node, Flutter), I manage the entire product lifecycle. My main focus is precision engineering: from robust backend logic to an impeccable User Experience (UX) that ensures system adoption.
About.description3: Based in Guadalajara, Mexico. My methodology is built on dynamic collaboration and delivering software that generates a measurable real-world impact, whether remotely or on-site.
